journey.name: app status spark row
journey.description:
App Status shows a Spark row under Lightning Connection on builds where Spark is supported, and the row opens Spark's detail screen. A dev build on regtest always supports Spark; the row reads Connected once Spark reaches Lightspark's hosted regtest, Connecting before that, and Offline without internet or after a failed start. Reaching the hosted regtest is not a journey capability, so the checks accept any of the three.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with no channel, start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (testTag "HeaderMenu") and tap App Status (testTag "DrawerAppStatus")
Verify a row titled "Spark" (testTag "Status-spark") sits directly under Lightning Connection (testTag "Status-lightning_connection") and reads "Connected", "Connecting..." or "Offline"
Tap the Spark row and verify Spark's detail screen opens
